details: Vulnerability in the PeopleSoft Enterprise FIN Inventory Brazil product of Oracle PeopleSoft (component: Inventory).   The supported version that is affected is 9.1. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with logon to the infrastructure where PeopleSoft Enterprise FIN Inventory Brazil executes to compromise PeopleSoft Enterprise FIN Inventory Brazil.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of PeopleSoft Enterprise FIN Inventory Brazil accessible data and unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service (partial DOS) of PeopleSoft Enterprise FIN Inventory Brazil. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 4.4 (Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:L).
